content.title: 定语从句·关系副词 when / where / why 与「介词+which」速查
content.intro: 关系副词在从句中作状语(时间/地点/原因),等于「介词+which」。判断口诀:从句缺状语→用关系副词,缺主语/宾语→用关系代词 that/which。介词后只能用 which,不可用 that/where/when。

headers: 用法 / 例句 / 等价
rows: 地点先行词(zoo/park/island/place):the zoo where = in/at which
时间先行词(day/season/year/moment):the day when = on/in/during which
原因(reason):the reason why = for which
从句缺主宾、或更正式:on which / in which / by which / to which

specialRules.rule: 从句只缺状语(时间/地点/原因)→ 才用关系副词
specialRules.mark: the island where it could swim(缺地点状语)

specialRules.rule: 从句缺主语/宾语 → 即使先行词是时间/地点也用 that/which
specialRules.mark: the penguin that he rescued(缺宾语→that)

specialRules.rule: the place where = in/at which;the day when = on/in which;the reason why = for which
介词后只能用 which,不可用 that/where/when
specialRules.mark: the boat in which √ / in that ×

why: 关系副词 = 介词 + which,在从句里充当状语,所以从句的主语、宾语都不缺;一旦主语或宾语缺了,就要换成关系代词 that/which。介词提前到关系词前时,只能配 which。
gaokaoPoints: where/when/why 与 which/that 的判断(看从句缺什么成分:缺状语→副词,缺主宾→代词);语法填空与单选高频。
「介词+which」结构:the day on which / the place in which / a means by which;介词后绝不用 that。

examVsReal.exam: the zoo where I saw the panda(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: the zoo I saw the panda in
examVsReal.note: 考试用 where;口语常省略关系词、把介词放句末

examVsReal.exam: the reason why animals sleep(考试)
examVsReal.real: the reason animals sleep / the reason that animals sleep
examVsReal.note: 考试用 why;口语里 why 常被省略或用 that
